title: 第六十回 子枭独巢第五十九回 灸世仙人
slug: 驭音心经第七十回狼心逞乱
lines: 次日拂晓，天光未彻，寒氲如纱，四皇子御驾还宫。
十三皇子策马随行，搦一雪球于手中，若有所思。
四皇子侧首问：“十三弟，因何不说话？”
十三皇子沉吟片刻：“四哥，哦不，万岁，臣弟方才思虑一人。”
“何人？”
“废太子。”
“为何？”
“臣弟在想，其已贵为太子，为何还做出这种不伦之事？”
四皇子仰首轻叹，呵气成霜：“哎，岂止是你，朕亦是不解。
若论天运，其已储君，却为一女子背弃人伦，落得幽锁深宫，如同死囚，何其悲哉！”
十三皇子转瞬一笑，四皇子诧异：“十三弟因何失笑？”
十三皇子回答：“四哥，哦不，万岁，臣弟想明白矣。”
四皇子笑：“你想明白什么？”
“天命，一切皆系天命！”
十三皇子说着，掷出手中雪球，吐出一团若云寒气，如释重负。
“无德而小，有道乃大。
废太子本无德义，自然不能赢圣望，受天命，焉何不失大位？陛下继承大统，顺天应人，厚德载物，是圣望，亦是民心。
弟看皇上，不禁这大位坐得稳，更能把这大位传与子子孙孙。”
四皇子淡然一笑：“十三弟过誉。
朕不求百世，惟求革除弊治，勤政安民，上不负先帝，下不负苍生。”
正言间，忽听前方人声喧哗，十三皇子问：“前方何事？”
一侍卫过来回禀：“回圣上和十三爷，前方百姓夹道，欲睹圣颜，侍卫们恐生变乱，正行驱赶。”
四皇子蹙眉：“新帝登基，子民好奇，围观是常情，何故驱赶？莫要伤了百姓，令其退避两旁即可。”
十三皇子谏：“陛下不可！
清街封道为防奸人作乱，乃世袭之礼。
此例一开，恐遗后患。”
四皇子笑：“怎会……？”
话音未落，一阵清铃声破空而来：“孤作天龙，孤作天龙！”
一道人手执铜铃，悠然穿过仪仗，其身如魅，其影飘蓬。
更奇者，其后一幡，凌空舞动，飒飒飘飘，似有隐者背后擎之！
四皇子脸色一沉：“此山眉道人，滥施妖术，蛊惑人心，其心可诛！”
十三皇子低声道：“陛下，是否擒之？”
四皇子摆手：“不，若擒也非擒他。”
十三皇子闻言，眼眸一闪：“那擒八弟府中的天师？”
四皇子笑而不答，目光深远。
守灵至午膳时分，新皇上起身，众皇子皆随起身。
九皇子抚腹，刚欲言“饿死了”
，却闻天子发话：“诸弟留步，朕有数言。”
九皇子小声嘀咕，四皇子冷眼掠过，不怒自威。
待众人落定，四皇子目视一眼隆中堂，缓声道：“隆中堂一早即来候旨，然朕有言在先：守灵期间，万事皆缓。
尔等是否以为，朕这个皇帝做的很悠闲？”
“尔等错了。
尔等未曾看到，朕即使用膳，亦不过匆匆几口。
content_en:
At dawn the next day, before the light was clear and the air was as cold as a veil, the fourth prince returned to the palace.
The Thirteenth Prince rode his horse to accompany him, holding a snowball in his hand, thoughtfully.
The fourth prince tilted his head and asked, "Thirteenth brother, why don't you speak?"
The Thirteenth Prince pondered for a moment: "Fourth brother, oh no, long live, I just had someone to think about."
"Who?"
"The deposed prince."
"Why?"
"My younger brother is thinking, since he is already the crown prince, why would he do such an unethical thing?"
The fourth prince raised his head and sighed softly, exhaling into frost: "Hey, it's not just you, I am also confused.
In terms of destiny, it is so tragic that he has become the heir, but he has betrayed human relations for a woman and ended up locked up in a deep palace, like a prisoner on death row! "
The thirteenth prince suddenly smiled, and the fourth prince was surprised: "Why did the thirteenth brother lose his smile?"
The thirteenth prince replied: "Fourth brother, oh no, long live my brother, I want to understand."
The fourth prince smiled: "What do you want to understand?"
"Destiny, everything is destiny!"
The Thirteenth Prince said as he threw the snowball in his hand and exhaled a cloud of cold air, feeling relieved.
“Without virtue, one is small, but with Tao, one is great.
The deposed prince has no virtue and righteousness. Naturally, he cannot win the Holy Hope. If he receives the destiny, why not lose his position? Your Majesty inherits the great authority, obeys nature and responds to people, and is virtuous. This is the hope of the saints and the hearts of the people.
Looking at the Emperor, I can't help but feel that this great position is secure and that I can pass this great title on to my descendants. "
The fourth prince smiled calmly: "Thirteenth brother is too praised.
I do not seek to live forever, but to eradicate bad governance, work diligently to bring peace to the people, and live up to my late emperor and the common people. "
While he was talking, he suddenly heard the noise in front of him, and the Thirteenth Prince asked: "What's going on ahead?"
A guard came over and reported: "Back to the Holy Master and the Thirteenth Master, the people in front of us are blocking the road, hoping to see the Holy Face. The guards are afraid of causing chaos, so they are driving away."
The fourth prince frowned: "When the new emperor ascends the throne, it is normal for the people to be curious and watch. Why drive them away? Don't hurt the people, just ask them to retreat."
The Thirteenth Prince admonished: "Your Majesty, no!
Clearing streets and sealing roads is a hereditary ritual to prevent traitors from causing trouble.
Once this case is opened, there may be future troubles. "
The fourth prince smiled: "How could...?"
Before he finished speaking, a clear ringtone came through the air: "I am a heavenly dragon alone, I am a heavenly dragon alone!"
A man holding a copper bell walked leisurely through the ceremonial guard. His body was like a charm, and his shadow was fluttering.
What's even more surprising is that a flag behind him is dancing and fluttering in the air, as if there is a hermit holding it behind his back!
The fourth prince's face darkened: "This Shanmei Taoist is using sorcery indiscriminately to deceive people's hearts. His heart can be killed!"
The Thirteenth Prince whispered: "Your Majesty, do you want to capture him?"
The fourth prince waved his hand: "No, if you want to capture him, you can't capture him."
When the Thirteenth Prince heard this, his eyes flashed: "What about capturing the Heavenly Master in the eighth brother's house?"
The fourth prince smiled but did not answer, his eyes far-reaching.
When the vigil was over and it was time for lunch, the new emperor stood up, followed by all the princes.
The Ninth Prince stroked his belly and was about to say, "I'm starving to death."
, but heard the emperor say: "Brothers, please stay, I have a few words."
The Ninth Prince muttered in a low voice, while the Fourth Prince glanced at him coldly, showing his composure without anger.
After everyone settled down, the fourth prince glanced at Longzhongtang and said slowly: "Longzhongtang came early in the morning to await orders, but I have something to say first: During the wake, everything will be slow.
Do you think that I, the emperor, am doing things very leisurely? "
"You were wrong.
You guys haven't seen it. Even if I eat, it will only be a few hurried bites.
